## Checklist

<!-- All items must be checked before the PR is ready for review. -->

- [ ] Code follows the project conventions (Clean Architecture, SOLID, DRY, KISS, feature-first)
- [ ] Public functions and classes are documented
- [ ] No TODOs, placeholders, or fake implementations
- [ ] Tests added or updated for changed behavior
- [ ] All tests pass locally
- [ ] Lint and formatting pass (`dart format` / Ruff / Prettier as applicable)
- [ ] User-facing strings use translation keys (no hardcoded prose)
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or personal data introduced
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated where behavior changed
- [ ] Documentation updated where needed
